data.name: Suvankar
data.gender_notes: Suvankar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'su' meaning good and 'vankar' meaning conqueror or victorious. It symbolizes the strength and intelligence of a person who is able to overcome obstacles in life. The name Suvankar carries the meaning “Good Conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Suvankar usually hope their child will grow to embody good conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Suvankar is a name that resonates with the energy of victory and strength. It represents the inner power and determination to overcome challenges and achieve success.
data.etymology: Suvankar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good Conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suvankar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_sanskrit.name: सुवान्कर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good, auspicious, prosperous, वान् (vān) meaning vehicle, कर (kar) meaning doing. Thus, Suvankar means one who does good and auspicious deeds, one who is victorious and prosperous.
